roads.name: Antelope Island Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 15 curves in 3.9 miles.
From 4,218 to 4,447 ft, with 357 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 30 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.13 g.
